entries.claim: Execute-workflow code review ends in exactly one integration pass that applies the residue findings.
entries.witness:
one parallel review wave, then exactly one integration pass
code review is one parallel wave plus one integration pass

entries.claim: On a DoE box, plain `claude` is coordinator-less by design and only the DoE launcher loads the coordinator plugin.
entries.witness:
plain claude is coordinator-less by design
the installer never registers or installs the coordinator plugin
the launcher is the only way a DoE box loads coordinator
